name: COSMOS
recent: COSMOS 于 2026 年 10 月 19 日宣布拟以 1652 万令吉收购 Orisystems 51% 股权，并签署不具约束力的意向书；此前一周公司获得 393 万令吉供应合约。2026 年 10 月 20 日，公司第七届常年股东大会所有决议均获通过。近期亦有主要股东及董事的股权变动申报。
notable: 拟以 1652 万令吉收购 Orisystems 51% 股权，已签署不具约束力的意向书。
获得价值 393 万令吉的供应合约。
第七届常年股东大会所有决议获股东通过。
risks: 收购 Orisystems 51% 股权仅处于不具约束力的意向书阶段，尚未签署最终协议。
董事 Dato' Chong Toh Wee 于 2025 年 10 月 15 日以 202 万令吉收购 513 万股（1.999%）。

recent_en: On 19 October 2026, COSMOS announced a proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Orisystems for RM16.52 million via a non-binding letter of intent, after securing a RM3.93 million supply contract a week earlier. All resolutions were passed at the company's 7th AGM on 20 October 2026. There were also recent notifications of changes in substantial shareholders' and directors' interests.
notable_en: Proposed acquisition of a 51% stake in Orisystems for RM16.52 million via a non-binding letter of intent.
Secured a supply contract worth RM3.93 million.
All resolutions passed at the 7th Annual General Meeting.
risks_en: The acquisition of a 51% stake in Orisystems is at a non-binding letter of intent stage; no definitive agreement has been signed.
Substantial shareholder MSM INTERNATIONAL LIMITED ceased to be a shareholder on 15 October 2026 (Notice of Person Ceasing).
Director Dato' Chong Toh Wee acquired 5.13 million shares (1.999%) for RM2.02 million on 15 October 2025.
